sources.entry: Damselfly - Fast server-based photo management system for large collections of images. Includes face detection, face & object recognition, powerful search, and EXIF Keyword tagging. Runs on Linux, MacOS and Windows. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/C#/.NET

summary.one_liner: Damselfly is a server-based digital photo management system for large folder-based image collections, with fast search, keyword tagging, and local ML-based face and object recognition.
summary.what_it_does: Damselfly indexes folder-based photo libraries on a server and serves them through a web front-end, so images can be browsed without copying catalogues to each device. It supports many formats including JPG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, WebP, BMP and RAW files (DNG, CR2, ORF, NEF). It offers full-text and advanced search (date ranges, objects, faces, camera/lens, file size, orientation, visually similar images), and keyword tagging that writes EXIF data via ExifTool without re-encoding JPEGs. Face detection, face recognition and object detection run locally and offline. A selection basket lets users collect images for download, export, watermarking, or upload to WordPress, and a desktop client can sync basket images to a local folder. Multi-user accounts with roles (e.g., ReadOnly) are supported.
use_cases: Manage a large personal photo library on a home server
Search thousands of photos by keyword, date, camera or subject
Tag people once and find other photos of them automatically
Share a photo library across multiple devices via the browser
Select photos into a basket and sync them to a laptop for editing
Watermark photos for social media or email
how_to_run: Run in Docker (the README states it runs in Docker; see the Installation docs linked from the README for specific steps)
notable: Local, offline face detection and recognition, replacing the earlier Microsoft Azure Face API dependency
Non-destructive EXIF keyword writes via ExifTool, so JPEGs are not re-encoded
Picasa-inspired UI with a selection basket that can be shared between users
Automatic background indexing and thumbnail generation for folders on the server
Exclude folders from scanning by placing a .nomedia file in them
caveats: Desktop client is built on Electron.Net and the README lists Windows, macOS and Linux desktop versions; the server platforms are Windows, Linux, OSX and Docker
Simple editing, image de-duplication and Alamy upload are listed as planned or in progress, not finished
Video support is not provided; it is listed only as a possible future addition
